```{r}
library(airway)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(readr)


data(airway)

```


```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSet(airway, design = ~cell + dex)

dds$dex <- relevel(dds$dex, ref = "untrt")# set untrt as reference

# by default the levels are set alphabetically so it is good to check
# the level to make sure the reference is correctly assigned

dds
```


```{r}
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >=10) >=4 # keep the rows where more than four

#samples have >= 10 counts

dds <- dds[keep, ] # remove the row that do not meet the keep criteria

nrow(dds)


```

```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds) # Run the DESeq analysis
```
```{r}

plotDispEsts(dds) # plot the dispersion estimates

res <- results(dds)

res

summary(res)
```

```{r}
summary(res, alpha = 0.05)

sum(res$padj <0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# convert Ensembl IDs to symbols using the rowData we noticed last week

gene_meta <- rowData(dds)

head(gene_meta[, c("gene_id", "symbol")])

# find FKBP5 (one of your predicted up-with-dex genes)
fkbp5_id <- gene_meta$gene_id[gene_meta$symbol == "FKBP5"]

fkbp5_id

res[fkbp5_id, ]

```



```{r}
# helper to look up a gene by symbol
look_up <- function(symbol) {
  ids <- gene_meta$gene_id[gene_meta$symbol == symbol]
  res[ids, ]
}

# your predicted up-with-dex genes
look_up("FKBP5")
look_up("DUSP1")
look_up("TSC22D3")
look_up("KLF15")
look_up("PER1")

# your predicted down-with-dex genes
look_up("IL6")
look_up("PTGS2")
look_up("CCL2")

# your predicted unchanged genes
look_up("ACTB")
look_up("GAPDH")
```

```{r}
plotMA(res, ylim = c(-6, 6))

```
```{r}

hist(res$pvalue, breaks = 50, col = "grey",
     main = "p-value histogram", xlab = "p-value")

```


```{r}

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("dex", "cell"))

```
```{r}


res_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "dex_trt_vs_untrt", type = "apeglm")



plotMA(res_shrunk, ylim = c(-5, 5))


```

```{r}

# save the results properly
results_df <- as.data.frame(res) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ensembl_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    as.data.frame(rowData(dds))[, c("gene_id", "symbol")],
    by = c("ensembl_id" = "gene_id")
  )

write_tsv(results_df, "../results/tables/airway_dex_results.tsv")

# session info for reproducibility
sessionInfo()

```

## Week 2 summary

- Ran DESeq2 on airway dataset, n=4 paired donors, dex vs untrt
- Pre-filtered 63,677 → 16,139 expressed genes
- Found 4,905 DEGs at padj < 0.1; ~30% of expressed transcriptome
- All five predicted GR transactivation targets confirmed (FKBP5, DUSP1, TSC22D3, KLF15, PER1)
- Predicted suppression genes (IL6, PTGS2, CCL2) all moved correct direction; effects modest as expected for unstimulated cells
- ACTB unexpectedly upregulated (~1.8x, padj 0.008); reinforces that no gene is universally invariant
- All four diagnostics (dispersion, MA, p-value histogram, PCA) clean

## Key concepts internalized
- Negative binomial = Poisson + biological overdispersion
- Composition bias and median-of-ratios normalization
- Paired design via blocking factor in formula
- Empirical Bayes shrinkage (dispersions and fold changes)
- Why p-value histogram shape matters
